meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for "write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /caveman-commit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浓缩代码改动为一句提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为提交信息措辞犯难,希望留下清晰记录。
copy.tagline_en: Condense code changes into one commit message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with commit messages and want clean history.

howto.what: Claude 会把你的改动写成一条 Conventional Commits 格式的提交信息,只讲意图、不写废话;只输出可直接粘贴的信息块,不执行 git commit、不暂存文件。
howto.when: 当你说 “write a commit”“commit message”,或输入 /commit 等命令时触发;说 “stop caveman-commit” 或 “normal mode” 会切回啰嗦的提交风格。

say.text: 帮我写这次改动的 commit message
say.note: 输出一条 Conventional Commits 格式信息

say.text: 给这个破坏性改动写提交信息
say.note: 会附上 BREAKING CHANGE 正文
只输出信息块,不执行提交

howto.what_en: Claude turns your changes into a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only, with no fluff. It outputs just a paste-ready code block; it does not run git commit, stage files, or amend.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "write a commit" or "commit message", or type /commit or /caveman-commit. Saying "stop caveman-commit" or "normal mode" reverts to verbose commit style.

say_en.text: Write a commit message for these changes
Write a commit message for this breaking change
Use /caveman-commit to write the commit message
say_en.note: Outputs only a paste-ready code block
